headnotes.text: Where the record lacks evidence that a disability claimant cannot engage in substantial gainful activity, a district court errs in remanding for an award of benefits; it should remand to the Secretary to take evidence and make findings on the disability, ability to do former work, other work the claimant can perform, and its availability.
